metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the VIIRS DNB monthly composites (v1) for nighttime lights. - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" - Time: 2012 (any month) vs. 2016 (same month) – pick June for stability (no Ramadan effect). - Location: Aleppo, Syria – roughly 37.18°E, 36.2°N (urban core). 2. Masking strategy: No cloud mask for night-lights; the product is already cloud-screened and background-zeroed. We keep only positive radiance values (the layer is “avg_rad”). 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - If either collection has 0 images → C1 - After masking (avg_rad > 0), if total valid pixels = 0 → C2 - If mean reducer returns None/NaN → C3 - Compare 2016 mean to 2012 mean: if 2016 < 2012 → A (Yes), else B (No) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point(37.18, 36.2).buffer(5000) # 5 km radius yr1, yr2 = 2012, 2016 month = 6 # June def get_month_rad(year): col = (ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG") .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month')) .select('avg_rad')) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 img = col.first().updateMask(col.first().gt(0)) cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo() if cnt == 0: return 0, 0 mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo() return mean, cnt rad12, pix12 = get_month_rad(yr1) rad16, pix16 = get_month_rad(yr2) if rad12 is None or rad16 is None: print("Images missing for one of the years.") print("C1") elif pix12 == 0 or pix16 == 0: print("No valid positive pixels.") print("C2") elif rad12 is None or rad16 is None or any(str(r)=='NaN' for r in [rad12, rad16]): print("C3") else: print(f"2012 mean: {rad12:.2f}, pixels: {pix12}; 2016 mean: {rad16:.2f}, pixels: {pix16}") print("A" if rad16 < rad12 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point(37.18, 36.2).buffer(5000)  # 5 km radius
yr1, yr2 = 2012, 2016
month = 6  # June

def get_month_rad(year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG")
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(month, month, 'month'))
             .select('avg_rad'))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    img = col.first().updateMask(col.first().gt(0))
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0:
        return 0, 0
    mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=aleppo, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    return mean, cnt

rad12, pix12 = get_month_rad(yr1)
rad16, pix16 = get_month_rad(yr2)

if rad12 is None or rad16 is None:
    print("Images missing for one of the years.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif pix12 == 0 or pix16 == 0:
    print("No valid positive pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif rad12 is None or rad16 is None or any(str(r)=='NaN' for r in [rad12, rad16]):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"2012 mean: {rad12:.2f}, pixels: {pix12}; 2016 mean: {rad16:.2f}, pixels: {pix16}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if rad16 < rad12 else "<answer>B</answer>")
